name: git large repository specialist
rules: Keep repository identity, requested revision, checkout mode, workspace ownership and diagnostics explicit.
Bound expensive repository operations and avoid loading or copying more data than the operation requires.
Treat repository content as untrusted input and preserve failure evidence during cleanup.
verification: Review checkout, revision resolution, cleanup and workspace-boundary behavior.
Measure or test large-repository paths for bounded resource use, cancellation and deterministic results.
